ambiguity: GLOSS.area-of-effect ambiguity 2: 'To block a line, an obstruction must provide Total Cover': judged per location (cut off only when a target there has Total Cover from the origin) or per line (any line through a solid part is blocked)?
ruling: Per location: a location is cut off from the area exactly when a creature or object there has Total Cover from the point of origin. A Three-Quarters obstruction such as an arrow slit never cuts anything off. With R-09, creatures never block an area.
